page: Server Timing API plugin for performance auditing. Install @elysia/server-timing. Appends Server-Timing header with log duration, function name, detail. Browser developer tools > Network > Timing to inspect. Config: enabled (default NODE_ENV !== 'production'), allow condition, trace lifecycle events. Trace types: request, parse, transform, beforeHandle, handle, afterHandle, total. Performance bottleneck auditing.

sections.manifest: Config options. enabled boolean default NODE_ENV !== 'production'. allow undefined condition function. trace undefined lifecycle events array. Trace types: request, parse, transform, beforeHandle, handle, afterHandle, total durations.
Allow condition disable on specific routes. Allow function returns boolean based on request URL. Disable on /no-trace path example.
